desc:
🕒 welcome to TWS, an incremental game where you start with the simplest of basics and climb your way up to TIME TRAVEL with OP gear!

👁 DON'T LET THE GAME'S NAME FOOL YOU... this game's content (made over the course of 7 years mind you!) goes INSANELY DEEP. once you get invested, you will wish you played sooner!
❓ Make sure to use ADVENTURER'S GUIDE BOOK to guide you through your journey!
✨ Love cosmetics? WE GOT YOU! There's plenty of different things you can get dripped out with!
💭 BRING FRIENDS to make your grinds all the more fun and rewarding in the end! Some mechanics later on do rely on teamwork!

⭐ PLUS USERS passively gain ticks (PREMIUM CURRENCY) for simply staying in the game!
📡 Don't worry about disconnecting from the game, it will reconnect you by itself! (hopefully (no promises! (it does work though!)))
